104:1: Woe to every backbiter, one who mocks with gestures!
104:2: Who amasses wealth and counts it.
104:3: He thinks that his wealth has made him immortal.
104:4: Nay, he will surely be thrown into al-Hutamah.
104:5: What has made you know what al-Hutamah is?
104:8: Indeed, it is closed over them,
